notes.title: We're creating a new horror RPG!
notes.content:
Greetings, fans of Seven Mysteries!
We're thrilled to reveal that we're currently developing a brand-new horror RPG named "[b]Into Samomor.[/b]" This upcoming title promises to captivate you with its choice-driven mechanics, high-octane action, unsettling atmospheres, and a dash of dark humor.

[previewyoutube=XPsYFF5wDgo;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Into Samomor story:[/b]
In the quaint town of Samomor, a resident disappears without a trace every year. They all had one thing in common: they were last spotted standing before the Samomor Forest on the day they went missing. After nearly a year of tranquility, the time has come for a new disappearance. However, this time, an unexpected twist will change the course of events. A force from another world and a teenager will team up to solve what's behind it all.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2373890/ss_338470cd23b63bc0138839cdc8586a84bd6a6e95.1920x1080.jpg?t=1696150343[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2373890/ss_b414eef1773fc22475355a94a3d09900e629d707.1920x1080.jpg?t=1696150343[/img]

There's a free demo available right now on Steam. Wishlist the game and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/W4YJ7PrSe5]Discord [/url]for upcoming devlogs and updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2373890/Into_Samomor/

notes.title: Seven Mysteries: The Last Page Patch 2.0.0 Now Available [02/14/18]
notes.content:
A new patch has been released for Seven Mysteries: The Last Page that consists of the following changes:

► New UI
► New resolution (16:9)
► Graphics improvement
► Faster Performances
► Mouse supports
► New language: Simplified Chinese
► Easier to get to chapter 7
► Bug fixed: FPS drops randomly

Before you update: All your save files on old version won’t work on this version. We're sorry for this inconvenience. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to tell us. :)

Best Regards,

Behind The Door Games
